name: Fabrication Moon Alvaris
background: The Fabrication Moon Alvaris, a chapter steeped in industry and faith, fields vast hordes alongside devastating long-range firepower. Central to their might are the towering Sacred Automatons, embodiments of divine wrath. They overwhelm foes with sheer numbers and rain destruction from afar, a relentless force defending their allies with zeal and steel.
backgroundFull:
The Fabrication Moon Alvaris, is a testament to the union of relentless industry and unwavering faith. Emerging from the depths of a vast mechanized moon, this chapter stands as a bulwark against the encroaching darkness, its ranks swelled with legions of tireless automatons and devout followers.

At the heart of their strategy lies an overwhelming tide of horde units, countless in number and unyielding in their advance. These legions, meticulously crafted and tirelessly maintained, sweep across the battlefield with unrelenting determination, overwhelming foes with sheer numbers alone.

But it is not merely brute force that defines the Fabrication Moon Alvaris. From the depths of their moon-forges come devastating long-range weapons, raining destruction upon their enemies from afar. Their mastery of ranged warfare is unparalleled, as they rain down death upon their foes with precision and efficiency.

Central to their arsenal are the Sacred Automatons, towering constructs of metal and might imbued with sacred purpose. These colossal war machines stride across the battlefield, shrugging off enemy fire as they unleash devastating salvos upon their foes. Each one a testament to the ingenuity and zeal of their creators, these Sacred Automatons are revered as instruments of divine wrath, striking fear into the hearts of all who oppose the Fabrication Moon Alvaris.

In battle, the Fabrication Moon Alvaris is an unstoppable force, a relentless tide of steel and faith that crushes all who dare to stand in their way. With their horde units overwhelming foes in close combat and their long-range firepower raining death from above, they stand as an unyielding bulwark against the darkness, ready to defend the Imperium at any cost.

customRules.name: Mechanical Tendrils
customRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets AP(+1) on their weapons in melee against once (next time the effect would apply).

customRules.name: Irradiated Aura
customRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Bane on their weapons when attacking against once (next time the effect would apply).

customRules.name: Shock
customRules.description: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

customRules.name: Execution OLD
customRules.description: This model and its unit get No Retreat.

customRules.name: Heal
customRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it.

customRules.name: Heavy Shield OLD
customRules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

customRules.name: Psalms
customRules.description: This model and its unit moves +2" when using Advance actions and +4" when using Rush/Charge actions.

spells.name: Hunker Down
spells.effect: Target friendly unit within 12" gets +1 to hit rolls when using Hold actions and shooting once (next time the effect would apply).
spells.effectSkirmish: Target 2 friendly units within 12" get +1 to hit rolls when using Hold actions and shooting once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Focused Beam
spells.effect: Target enemy unit within 12" takes 2 hits with AP(2).
spells.effectSkirmish: Target enemy unit within 12" takes 1 hit with AP(2).

spells.name: Take Aim
spells.effect: Target 2 friendly unit within 12" get +1 to hit rolls when shooting once (next time the effect would apply).
spells.effectSkirmish: Target 4 friendly units within 12" get +1 to hit rolls when shooting once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Grenade
spells.effect: Target enemy unit within 18” takes 1 hit with Blast(6).
spells.effectSkirmish: Target enemy unit within 18” takes 1 hit with Blast(3).

spells.name: Corrosive Mist
spells.effect: Target 2 enemy units within 18" get -2 to defense rolls once (next time the effect would apply).
spells.effectSkirmish: Target 4 enemy units within 18" get -2 to defense rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Shatter Bomb
spells.effect: Target enemy unit within 12" takes 6 hits with AP(2).
spells.effectSkirmish: Target enemy unit within 12" takes 3 hits with AP(2).

specialRules.name: Shielded
specialRules.description: Units where most models have this rule get +1 to Defense rolls against hits that are not from spells.

specialRules.name: Crossing Attack
specialRules.description: Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and roll X dice. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.

specialRules.name: Protected
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Fortified
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Mend
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it.

specialRules.name: Shred when Shooting Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Shred on its weapons when shooting.

specialRules.name: Hit & Run Shooter Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Hit & Run Shooter.

specialRules.name: Increased Shooting Range Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +6" range on its weapons when shooting once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Unstoppable
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.

specialRules.name: Quick Shot
specialRules.description: This model may shoot after using Rush actions.

specialRules.name: Anti-Cover
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

specialRules.name: Heavy Impact
specialRules.description: Counts as having Impact(X) with hits that have AP(1).

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: AP

specialRules.name: Tough
specialRules.description: This model must take X wounds before being killed. If a model with Tough joins a unit without it, then it is removed last when the unit takes wounds. You must continue to put wounds on the Tough model with most wounds in the unit until it is killed, before starting to put them on the next Tough model (Heroes must be assigned wounds last, even if already wounded).

specialRules.name: Shred
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.

specialRules.name: Hit & Run
specialRules.description: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after shooting or being in melee.

specialRules.name: Hit & Run Shooter
specialRules.description: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after shooting.

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Impact
specialRules.description: When charging, before either unit attacks, roll X dice, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 2+ the target takes 1 hit.

specialRules.name: Bane
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

specialRules.name: No Retreat
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a Morale Test that causes it to be Shaken or Routed, the test counts as passed instead. Then, roll as many dice as the number of wounds it would take to fully destroy it, and for each result of 1-3 the unit takes one wound, which can't be ignored.

specialRules.name: Blast
specialRules.description: If the target is hit all models within 4“ of it are also hit by this weapon.
